notes.title: Update 1.5.0
notes.content:
[h1]Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added button to main menu to join the Senile Zombies discord server
[*] Added option to invert mouse X- and Y-axis
[/list]
[h1]Balancing[/h1]
[list]
[*] Crystals rewarded for killing enemies are now split between all players instead of being awarded to all players
[*] Minimum mana regeneration delay increased from 0.1 to 0.2
[/list]
[h2]Mana Upgrade[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reduced mana regeneration delay reduction from 0.05 to 0.03
[/list]
[h2]Spell Upgrade[/h2]
[i]The Spell Upgrade was simplified, as it was unclear to players what the Spell Upgrade does exactly, since it was doing too much. It now only increases shooting speed and damage, and no longer increases the mana cost of shooting.[/i]
[list]
[*] Reduced mana cost increase of shooting from 2 to 0
[*] Reduced spell size increase from +1% to +0%
[/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed Lich boss maintaining focus on downed players
[*] Fixed "Joining..." spinner not being removed when joining failed
[*] Fixed multiple overlapping error windows being shown when failing to join multiplayer session
[*] Fixed changing lobby player slots breaking the online session so that no new players could join
[*] Fixed incorrect button text for clients on "Leave Lobby" button
[*] Fixed player leaving lobby remaining in the player list for the host
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.4.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added a new Lich boss that spawns every couple of rounds
[*] Rebalanced enemy scaling to be exponential. This means enemies will be easier in early rounds but much tougher in later rounds (especially on higher difficulties).
[*] Adjusted preset difficulties, overall making all of them slightly easier
[*] Fix enemies stopping moving when too many are spawned
[*] Added detailed enemy settings to lobby
[*] Added cheat settings to lobby
[*] Added button to revert settings back to their default values in the lobby
[*] Opening the in-game menu now pauses the game in singleplayer, or if you are the host
[/list]
